courseSteps.empty: The course has no steps yet.
courseSteps.note: Steps are read from the draft. Test blocks are never added.

course.cardsBlock: {count, plural, one {# flash card} other {# flash cards}}
course.readOnlyChat: You can read this workspace but not change it, so the chat is off.
course.readOnlySources: You can read this workspace but not change it.
course.readOnlyStudio: You can read this workspace but not change it.

author.placeholder: Ask for a plan, a lesson, a test…

starter.lesson: Write the lesson for the step
starter.test: Add a test with 5 questions to the step
starter.review: Review the course outline and point out the gaps

problem.empty-title: Every section and step needs a title.
problem.no-steps: Every section needs at least one step.

apply.title: Apply “{title}” to the course

description.course_plan: Creates the sections and steps the course draft does not have yet. Nothing changes for students until you publish.
description.lesson_draft: Writes the lesson into a step of the course draft. Nothing changes for students until you publish.
description.quiz: Adds the questions to a step of the course draft as a test block.
description.flashcards: Adds the cards to a step of the course draft as a flash cards block.

apply.planCounts: {sections, plural, one {# new section} other {# new sections}}, {steps, plural, one {# new step} other {# new steps}}. {existing, plural, one {# step already exists and stays} other {# steps already exist and stay}} as they are.
apply.newStep: A new step “{title}” will be created.
apply.appendTo: Blocks are added to the end of “{title}”.
apply.removedBlocks: {count, plural, one {# current block is removed} other {# current blocks are removed}}.
apply.addBriefs: Put the goals and the summary of each new step into its first text block
apply.conflict: The step changed meanwhile. The preview was reloaded; check it and apply again.
apply.donePlan: {sections, plural, one {# section} other {# sections}} and {steps, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}} created in the draft.
apply.doneStep: The step draft is updated. Review it in the editor, then publish.
